title: Single Dad Dilemma

titles: Single Dad Dilemma: Love in Chaos
Can He Risk It All? Single Dad Dilemma
description:
Get ready to dive into the highly praised world of Carla Sorensen's Single Dad Dilemma, a romance novel that's so much more than just a love story. In this book summary, we'll explore how the high-stakes world of professional football shatters a man's emotional defenses, leading to a surprising happily ever after.

Single Dad Dilemma by Carla Sorensen is a masterfully crafted romance novel that uses the high-pressure world of professional football to explore themes of emotional vulnerability, perfection, and spontaneity. Through the eyes of Barrett King, the youngest King brother and a single dad, we see a man struggling to balance his rigid defenses with the demands of his career and his growing feelings for Bridget, his assistant. As we delve into the world of Single Dad Dilemma, we'll analyze the crucial distinction between emotional isolation and the lack of skills, and how the author uses the setting of professional football to create a sense of force proximity, threatening the characters' defenses and pushing them to confront their vulnerabilities.
